answer: AI-agent markets for island logistics, garden sensors, or onyx assays can resist Sybil attacks via Proof of Space-Time. Each agent fills storage with lookup tables seeded by its public key and answers Merkle challenges from an epoch beacon before a tight timeout. Because plots cannot be shared across keys or recomputed in time, attackers incur persistent disk capacity per identity. However, cheap cloud storage lets funded adversaries rent bulk capacity to run multiple fake nodes.
